purpose: Permanent thin Google-native execution node for KIOAS without making KIOAS dependent on Apps Script.
state_projection: KIOAS Scientist + Genome Lab control plane
target_runtime: existing owner-private KIOAS Apps Script project
invariants: KIOAS core intelligence remains provider-neutral and outside GNEN
no secret persistence in Sheets, logs, receipts, GitHub or handoff envelopes
A2/A3 actions are held rather than executed by the command queue
exactly one command processor trigger and one heartbeat trigger
unchanged failed routes circuit-break into failure-to-win learning
source rollback is external and version-bound
provider/model authority never transfers from source presence
maturity_law: SOURCE_READY is not DEPLOYED and DEPLOYED is not PROVEN.
